risks.risk: Microwave may not heat properly (magnetron/transformer issue) even if it powers on.
risks.proof: A short video of a cup of water being heated (e.g., 30–60 seconds) with thermometer or visible steam, plus the microwave running timer clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not proven working (worst case: treat as needs testing/possible repair).

risks.risk: Door seal/latch may be faulty, causing leakage or failure to start.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the door seal/latch area and a video showing it starts reliably when the door is shut firmly.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as potential door/latch issue (worst case: may not start reliably).

risks.risk: Control panel/display may be partially defective (buttons/timer not responding).
risks.proof: Video showing multiple button presses and timer changes, with the display clearly readable.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as controls not fully confirmed (worst case: some buttons/timer may fail).

risks.risk: Unknown brand/model affects parts availability and comparable pricing.
risks.proof: Photo of the rating plate/model number sticker on the back/bottom (clear text).
risks.if_unproven: Price it at the generic microwave category level (worst case: lowest comparable).

risks.risk: Possible cosmetic damage not visible (cracks, dents, broken turntable) that affects usability/value.
risks.proof: Photos of the inside cavity, turntable/roller ring, and any dents/cracks from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as average condition with possible missing/defective accessories (worst case: turntable/parts not guaranteed).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the microwave rating plate/model number (back or bottom) so the exact model can be identified.
Video test: heating a cup of water for a short cycle with the timer/display readable.
Video showing it starts reliably and the turntable rotates (if present).
Close-up photos of the door seal/latch and the inside cavity (no cracks/burn marks).
Photo of any guarantee document/receipt and the guarantee terms (duration, what it covers).
response.reason: The item type is identifiable as a microwave oven, but the brand/model and key functional proof (heating test) are not visible. Without a clear running/heating demonstration and model plate, a safe worst-case price cannot be confidently set.
